remaining: Windows/BSD live ground truth and held-out corpus
60 resolved null trials per stratum and validated independence
review accuracy, failure and resource baselines before extending inference
limitations: This tests SACK negotiation, not OS or topology identification.
The proxy terminates TCP on its Linux frontend; HZ-001 does not handshake with its backend.
NAT is IPv4 only; IPv6 uses an explicitly routed path.
Netem randomness is not reproduced by the experiment ordering seed.
The one-port existing scanner baseline uses IPv4 raw SYN and IPv6 connect; it solves a different task and no speedup ratio is valid.
Runs may be dependent; the binomial bound is descriptive until stationarity and independence are established.
Unresolved, failed, missing and capture-dropped runs are retained and never counted as successful null trials.
